# Helping protect what matters most.

**

At Chubb, we deliver excellence in all we do, being there when you need us most. We provide
exceptional service to our customers and business partners—it's who we are.

chubb insurance

## Individuals & Families

Customized personal insurance to protect what matters most to you, and services that help prevent
loss - and cover it if it occurs.

## Businesses

Protection for your business, for your employees and your reputation - customized to the unique
needs of your industry - for businesses of all sizes.    

## Agents & Brokers

Chubb gives you all you need to offer clients a world-class experience, with tools and resources to
support your sales and business growth.

## Embedded Insurance - build potential revenue and customer satisfaction

Chubb's embedded insurance solutions are the seamless way to integrate customized coverage into the
products and services you already offer.
[ Learn More ][149]
[true]

## Chubb Celebrates America

For nearly as long as this nation has existed, Chubb has been here — insuring American homes,
businesses, and dreams through every chapter of this country’s story. 

[ Explore Chubb's story ][150]
Why Chubb

### Insurance excellence is our starting point

$200B+
Global assets backing our financial strength
$21B
Claims paid out globally (2023)
54
Countries where claims teams operate
Over 200
Insurance products and client services
The Claims Difference

### We don’t just process claims. We make things right.

At Chubb, the claims process is different. Our experienced claims specialists are relentless about
every detail in the most personal way possible. Whether you have a business, homeowners or auto
policy, it's our policy to make your life easier. 

[ Learn More ][151]
Careers

### Join our talent network

Whether you choose to apply today or simply leave your information, the Chubb team looks forward to
staying connected with you. Join our Talent Network and receive updates about hiring at Chubb.

[ Explore Careers ][152]

## Get a quote that fits your unique needs

For individuals and businesses, Chubb provides proactive risk management guidance, coverage tailored
to your needs and exceptional claims service. Get your quote for business insurance or personal
insurance today.

## Comparing auto insurance quotes is easy

One of the best ways to save money on car insurance is to compare quotes. Prices can vary by
hundreds of dollars among companies, so time spent getting prices can really pay off.

It's easy to get quotes. EverQuote can match you to insurers that best fit you. And auto insurance
quotes are free - no matter who you get them from.

## Types of car insurance

It's good to have an idea of what kinds of auto insurance you want when you're ready to compare car
insurance quotes. Here are the main coverage types.

**Liability insurance.** This is required in most states and is the foundation of auto insurance
policies. Liability coverage pays others for accidents you cause, including injuries and property
damage. Note that liability insurance does not cover any damage to your own car.

**Collision insurance.** This pays for damage to your car if you hit something, such as a pole or
tree.

**Comprehensive insurance.** This pays out if your car is stolen. It also covers damage to you car
if you hit an animal or if you have damage from flood, fire, hail, vandalism or falling objects
(such as a tree branch).

**Uninsured motorist (UM) insurance.** If you're injured by a driver who has no liability insurance,
this coverage pays medical bills. In some states you can also buy a version that covers car damage
from an uninsured motorist.

**Personal injury protection (PIP) and medical payments (MedPay) coverage.** These pay for injuries
of you and your passengers, no matter who was at fault. Some states require PIP, where it is
sometimes called "no-fault insurance."

**Rental reimbursement insurance.** If your car is in the shop due to an accident covered by your
policy, this helps pay for a rental car. It typically has a daily and total maximum that it will
pay.

## How much auto insurance do you want?

Before you set out to compare car insurance, have an idea of what levels of coverage you want. The
minimum you must buy will be decided by your state. State requirements can include liability
insurance, uninsured motorist coverage, and personal injury protection (called PIP or no-fault). You
may want higher coverage levels for each than what's required.

Here are examples of levels of coverage for liability and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage.
Your own car insurance needs often depend on how many assets you would have at risk in a lawsuit
against you after a car crash. It also depends on whether you want insurance that will pay out for
damage such as hail, hitting a fence or having your car stolen.

**Highest Level**
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $100,000 property damage liability
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Typical Level**
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $50,000 property damage liability
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Lower Level**
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $25,000 property damage liability
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Minimum level (state requirements might be higher)**
* $15,000 per person / $30,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $5,000 property damage liability
* $15,000 per person/ $30,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

# **We Help You Compare Insurance Quotes Online**

If you want to own a car, a home, or a business, or simply want to protect your family’s health,
you’ll want to be insured. Getting coverage doesn’t have to be hard to do. NetQuote provides you
with the ability to compare multiple insurance quotes from some of the best insurance providers. We
make it fast, easy, and can help save you money.

## **How to Compare Insurance Rates**

Now that you can get insurance rates for free, you need to know how to compare insurance coverage so
that you are getting the best deal to protect your home, car, business, health or family. First, you
will fill out a simple form on NetQuote providing some information. You will start to receive quotes
based on your info. You then will want to compare a few policies from each company and see the
difference between:

A) Who offers the best price?

B) Who offers the most comprehensive coverage?

C) Who offers the most coverage for the best price?

One of the great things about NetQuote is convenience. Rather than having to do the research
yourself to get an insurance comparison, we do it for you. Filling out an insurance form can be time
consuming, but if you use a service like ours, you only have to fill out these questions once and
you can get as many as five insurance quotes from major providers within your area.

Without NetQuote, you not only have to reach out to those same companies individually and fill out
their questions each time, but you also have to make sure that you answer every question in the same
way each time. If you don’t, your insurance quotes won’t be apples to apples, and if you aren’t
making an accurate side-by-side comparison then you really aren’t judging each company’s policies
objectively.

## **The Cheap Insurance Myth**

It was once widely known that cheap insurance was just that: cheap insurance. It did not cost much,
but it also didn’t cover much. This is still true today in that you can find very inexpensive
policies that don’t cover very much; however, don’t be fooled into thinking that all cheap insurance
policies aren’t providing decent coverage.

Insurance companies are changing their insurance rates all the time. Sometimes they raise them when
there have been a large number of claims, and sometimes they lower rates when they are looking to
pick up more clients. What all of this amounts to is that a cheap policy might just represent a
market shift or a change in the needs of a particular company. In other words, an affordable policy
can still be a great option for your needs.

As you begin your search for insurance quote comparisons look to NetQuote as your guide. We make
sure that each home, health, auto, medicare, life and business insurance quote is based off of your
current needs and that you aren’t being fooled by any of the numbers. Ultimately, we all want to see
who will charge us the least for the exact same amount of insurance coverage without getting less
quality coverage So let us help you get the best insurance for your family, business and for your
money.

# **We Help You Compare Insurance Quotes Online**

If you want to own a car, a home, or a business, or simply want to protect your family’s health,
you’ll want to be insured. Getting coverage doesn’t have to be hard to do. NetQuote provides you
with the ability to compare multiple insurance quotes from some of the best insurance providers. We
make it fast, easy, and can help save you money.

## **How to Compare Insurance Rates**

Now that you can get insurance rates for free, you need to know how to compare insurance coverage so
that you are getting the best deal to protect your home, car, business, health or family. First, you
will fill out a simple form on NetQuote providing some information. You will start to receive quotes
based on your info. You then will want to compare a few policies from each company and see the
difference between:

A) Who offers the best price?

B) Who offers the most comprehensive coverage?

C) Who offers the most coverage for the best price?

One of the great things about NetQuote is convenience. Rather than having to do the research
yourself to get an insurance comparison, we do it for you. Filling out an insurance form can be time
consuming, but if you use a service like ours, you only have to fill out these questions once and
you can get as many as five insurance quotes from major providers within your area.

Without NetQuote, you not only have to reach out to those same companies individually and fill out
their questions each time, but you also have to make sure that you answer every question in the same
way each time. If you don’t, your insurance quotes won’t be apples to apples, and if you aren’t
making an accurate side-by-side comparison then you really aren’t judging each company’s policies
objectively.

## **The Cheap Insurance Myth**

It was once widely known that cheap insurance was just that: cheap insurance. It did not cost much,
but it also didn’t cover much. This is still true today in that you can find very inexpensive
policies that don’t cover very much; however, don’t be fooled into thinking that all cheap insurance
policies aren’t providing decent coverage.

Insurance companies are changing their insurance rates all the time. Sometimes they raise them when
there have been a large number of claims, and sometimes they lower rates when they are looking to
pick up more clients. What all of this amounts to is that a cheap policy might just represent a
market shift or a change in the needs of a particular company. In other words, an affordable policy
can still be a great option for your needs.

As you begin your search for insurance quote comparisons look to NetQuote as your guide. We make
sure that each home, health, auto, medicare, life and business insurance quote is based off of your
current needs and that you aren’t being fooled by any of the numbers. Ultimately, we all want to see
who will charge us the least for the exact same amount of insurance coverage without getting less
quality coverage So let us help you get the best insurance for your family, business and for your
money.

## **International Health Insurance for you and your family**

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

### **Contact**

If you're interested in getting international health insurance for you and your family, we'd be
delighted to speak with you by phone or email. You can also arrange for us to call you at the time
it suits you best.
[ LET US CALL YOU ][129]
[ +353 1 514 8480 ][130]
[Two women talking at work]

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Get answers to your questions quickly and easily with our handy FAQs.

[ Read the full FAQs ][131]

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

Struggling with sleep? Our new **Sleep Support Hub** is here to help. Discover practical tips,
expert articles, and wellbeing tools designed to support better rest - from winding down at night to
understanding common sleep challenges and available support. Small changes can make a big difference
to how you feel, day and night.

# Workplace Health & Wellbeing Solutions That Aim Higher

[ Connect with our team ][27]
[illustration-1]
[Wave separator]

## Trusted by Australia's leading companies, across multiple industries

Altius Wellbeing Spectrum

## There’s nothing linear about being human

As Australia's leading integrated workplace health and wellbeing partner, Altius is dedicated to
providing truly comprehensive health, wellbeing, safety, and performance support for you and your
people. Both physical and psychological. For any role, at any seniority, in any industry, wherever
your people are in their wellbeing journey.
Peak
For when your people who are healthy and well and looking to push performance. Our services combine
cutting edge, science-backed physical and psychological techniques to help your people achieve
optimal performance.
At Risk
Physical and Psychological stress often begins long before the point of injury or illness. Our risk
management solutions combine best in class wellbeing, psychological, and workplace health and safety
services to not only meet your legislative obligations but also aim for higher levels of wellbeing
overall.
Acute
When your people do unfortunately suffer physical and/or psychological injury, we are the leaders in
not only ensuring full and successful recovery but also supporting them through their return to the
workplace to ensure its a sustained return to wellbeing rather than simply a return to work.
Chronic
We offer a comprehensive suite of services to support anyone who suffers a severe or complex injury.
From clinical physical and psychological treatment, to return to work assessments, adaptations and
support - with you or a new employer - we have your people covered.
Our Services

## End-to-end services provide better health outcomes

Altius provides comprehensive corporate health, wellbeing, and safety solutions that create a
positive work environment and drive long-term, sustainable outcomes for your people and your
organisation. Our technology-enabled solutions address physical, mental, and social health,
delivering tailored support at every stage.
[ PeopleSense: Psychology & Wellbeing
[illustration services 1]
Invest in the wellbeing of your people with specialist workplace programs including; exercise
physiology, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and organisational development. Discover More ][28] [
Executive Health Solutions
[illustration services 2]
Optimise the performance of your people and your company with our professional, comprehensive,
evidence-based health programs. Discover More ][29] [ Rehabilitation Services
[illustration services 3]
Support your people to recover successfully from injury and/or illness with our multidisciplinary
rehabilitation solutions that navigate physical, medical, psychological, and social challenges.
Discover More ][30] [ Workplace Health & Safety
[illustration services 4]
Keep all of your employees safe with complete end-to-end solutions to manage your entire Workplace
Health & Safety (WHS) operations while supporting you with any WHS related issues that may arise.
Discover More ][31]

## Leading the way in workplace health and wellbeing

Our team of experts is focused on elevating the wellbeing of your people and your business. We
understand your employees and culture are your greatest assets, which is why our solutions empower
you to help your people to achieve more, whatever that means for them. With over 900 allied health
professionals delivering holistic care across 90 locations Australia-wide, Altius is your trusted
partner for truly comprehensive health, wellbeing, safety and performance solutions.
900 /90+
Altius has nine hundred staff spread across ninety locations in Australia
360 k
Over 360,000 people helped following temporary health setbacks or permanent disabilities.
600 k
Improved the wellbeing of over six hundred thousand Australians.

## Elevate your career with Altius

At Altius, we care about the wellbeing of our people, offering unlimited opportunities, all while
doing work that truly matters!

Altius Wellbeing Spectrum

## There’s nothing linear about being human

As Australia's leading integrated workplace health and wellbeing partner, Altius is dedicated to
providing truly comprehensive health, wellbeing, safety, and performance support for you and your
people. Both physical and psychological. For any role, at any seniority, in any industry, wherever
your people are in their wellbeing journey.
Peak
For when your people who are healthy and well and looking to push performance. Our services combine
cutting edge, science-backed physical and psychological techniques to help your people achieve
optimal performance.
At Risk
Physical and Psychological stress often begins long before the point of injury or illness. Our risk
management solutions combine best in class wellbeing, psychological, and workplace health and safety
services to not only meet your legislative obligations but also aim for higher levels of wellbeing
overall.
Acute
When your people do unfortunately suffer physical and/or psychological injury, we are the leaders in
not only ensuring full and successful recovery but also supporting them through their return to the
workplace to ensure its a sustained return to wellbeing rather than simply a return to work.
Chronic
We offer a comprehensive suite of services to support anyone who suffers a severe or complex injury.
From clinical physical and psychological treatment, to return to work assessments, adaptations and
support - with you or a new employer - we have your people covered.
Our Services

## End-to-end services provide better health outcomes

Altius provides comprehensive corporate health, wellbeing, and safety solutions that create a
positive work environment and drive long-term, sustainable outcomes for your people and your
organisation. Our technology-enabled solutions address physical, mental, and social health,
delivering tailored support at every stage.
[ PeopleSense: Psychology & Wellbeing
[illustration services 1]
Invest in the wellbeing of your people with specialist workplace programs including; exercise
physiology, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and organisational development. Discover More ][28] [
Executive Health Solutions
[illustration services 2]
Optimise the performance of your people and your company with our professional, comprehensive,
evidence-based health programs. Discover More ][29] [ Rehabilitation Services
[illustration services 3]
Support your people to recover successfully from injury and/or illness with our multidisciplinary
rehabilitation solutions that navigate physical, medical, psychological, and social challenges.
Discover More ][30] [ Workplace Health & Safety
[illustration services 4]
Keep all of your employees safe with complete end-to-end solutions to manage your entire Workplace
Health & Safety (WHS) operations while supporting you with any WHS related issues that may arise.
Discover More ][31]

## Leading the way in workplace health and wellbeing

Our team of experts is focused on elevating the wellbeing of your people and your business. We
understand your employees and culture are your greatest assets, which is why our solutions empower
you to help your people to achieve more, whatever that means for them. With over 900 allied health
professionals delivering holistic care across 90 locations Australia-wide, Altius is your trusted
partner for truly comprehensive health, wellbeing, safety and performance solutions.

# Accion Opportunity Fund

## Building
## more together

[Apply for a Loan][42]
[Find resources][43]

Small business owners need more than just financing. You need the practical tools, knowledge, and a
network that has your back. That’s where Accion Opportunity Fund steps in. We’re not just lenders;
we’re partners in your business who believe in your vision.

We provide real human support, expert guidance, and user-friendly technology to help you not only
succeed, but truly thrive. Our approach blends innovative digital tools with one-on-one advising,
giving personalized support that meets you where you are.

### Committed to making an impact for small business

As the nation’s leading nonprofit small business lender, AOF brings 30 years of experience serving
and advocating for small businesses across the country. We work at the local and national level to
advocate for policies, resources, and opportunities for small business owners who have historically
lacked access to affordable and responsible financing and the tools and resources to grow.

30+ years of service

4.5M+clients served across lending and learning

$1B+invested in small businesses

90%of our clients come from underserved communities

## Smart financing created for small business owners

Small businesses deserve a chance to prosper. That’s why our loans are built for you—transparent,
flexible, and free from hidden fees or predatory terms.

[Learn more about our loans][44]
Uli Nasibova, Uli’s Gelato

> The impact AOF will have on our business is very positive because we’re able to invest in
> inventory for the business.”
> 
> **Carlos Perez**
> Meat Town Distributors

Small Business Term Loans Truck Financing Food Truck Financing

Get the financing you need to expand, invest, and take your business to new heights.

Own your next commercial heavy and medium duty truck with financing designed to keep you moving
forward.

[Learn More][46]

## Food Truck Financing

Fire up your business with funding built for food business owners ready to hit the road.

[Learn more][47]

## Skill up your business

With AOF, you don’t just get access to affordable financing. You’ll have expert support at every
stage of your journey, along with tools and resources designed to empower your business.

[View resources][48]

### Business Advising

Get free guidance tailored to your unique challenges and goals. Our expert advisors help you tackle
everything from financial planning to marketing strategies.

[How It Works][49]

### Personalized Learning

Access resources and insights designed specifically for your business stage, your industry, and the
challenges you face.

[Learn More][50]

### Programs & Grants

Level up with workshops, training, and in-depth courses on essential topics like financial
management, growth strategies, and digital marketing.


[Explore][51]

### Discover everything you need to elevate your business.

With AOF, you don’t just get access to affordable financing. You’ll have expert support at every
stage of your journey, along with tools and resources designed to empower small business owners.

Questions

## What sellers ask before applying.

Is product liability insurance mandatory for Amazon sellers?

Yes. Amazon requires all sellers generating more than $10,000 in monthly revenue to maintain a
product liability policy. Assureful policies are fully compliant with Amazon's requirements and we
can send your certificate of insurance directly to Amazon on your behalf.

Does Assureful cover products imported from China?

Yes. We cover imported products from all countries including China, across 33,000+ product
categories. This is a key area where traditional insurers often decline coverage or charge
significantly more.

How does pay-as-you-sell work?

We connect directly to your Amazon or Shopify seller account and calculate your premium each month
based on your actual sales volume. No annual forecasts, no guesswork, no surprise audits. If your
sales go down, your premium goes down automatically.

Can I cancel my policy?

Yes. You can cancel at any time with 30 days' notice. There are no lock-in periods, no early
termination fees, and no penalties.

Is Assureful a broker?

No. Assureful is an insurance provider with delegated underwriting authority. We handle everything
directly - your data is never shared with third-party brokers.

What platforms does Assureful integrate with?

We integrate directly with Amazon and Shopify. When you connect your seller account, we
automatically pull your sales data to price your coverage accurately each month.

How fast does coverage start?

Coverage can start immediately after your application is approved. Most sellers are covered within
24 hours.

What does product liability insurance cover?

Product liability coverage protects you if a product you sell causes bodily injury or property
damage to a customer. This includes legal defence costs, settlements, and judgments.

Why do I need to connect my seller accounts?

By connecting your seller accounts, our AI Underwriting Engine can access your real-time sales data
to accurately rate the risk of your product mix and give you the best possible price. This
eliminates the need for annual revenue forecasts.

What products do you cover?

Assureful covers over 33,000+ product categories across Amazon and Shopify. We cover 95% of
products, including those manufactured in China.

Am I covered if I sell my products abroad?

Yes. Your Assureful policy covers global sales, so you're protected no matter where your customers
are located.

How do I make a claim?

Claims can be submitted through your online Assureful account. Our trusted claims administrator will
handle the process from there.

What do you do with my data?

Assureful respects your privacy and abides by laws and regulations related to data protection and
privacy, including maintaining SOC 2 compliance. We use your business data to ensure that our rating
of your business is accurate so you receive the best possible price.

[[Assureful]][30]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is AutoInsurance.org?

AutoInsurance.org is an online auto insurance marketplace and educational resource that helps
drivers [compare car insurance rates][140] from several top providers in one place.

We are an independent platform dedicated to helping you find the coverage you need at an affordable
price. While shopping for coverage, AutoInsurance.org serves as a convenient resource to help you
understand what each policy covers so you can confidently choose the right insurer and protection
level.

📊To get started, [enter your ZIP code][141] into our free tool to see side-by-side quotes from the
[best auto insurance companies][142] in just minutes.

### How does AutoInsurance.org work?

AutoInsurance.org’s [quote comparison tool][143] is a convenient way to compare multiple insurers at
once and find a personalized policy that meets your needs. Simply answer a few questions about your
coverage preferences and driving history to get a free, personalized quote in two minutes or less.

💲Our platform helps drivers save hundreds a year by offering instant, customized quotes, making it
one of the [best car insurance comparison sites][144].

### Are the quote tools at AutoInsurance.org free to use?

Yes. Our quote comparison tool is 100% free to use. You can explore various coverage types and
[compare auto insurance rates][145] with no fees or commitments.

🧾If you purchase a policy, you’ll complete the transaction directly through an insurer or licensed
agent. [Enter your ZIP code][146] to compare quotes easily on AutoInsurance.org and find affordable
coverage without the guesswork.

### What information do I need to compare quotes at AutoInsurance.org?

To generate accurate car insurance quotes on AutoInsurance.org’s platform, be prepared to enter:
* Your age and home address
* Your driver’s license number
* Details about your vehicle, including the year, make, model, and VIN
* How you use the car, such as daily commuting or personal driving
* Your driving history, including past insurance claims
* Your current coverage and the protection levels you want

📋Providing complete and up-to-date information helps the system return more precise rates from the
[best auto insurance companies.][147]

### How does AutoInsurance.org make money?

AutoInsurance.org earns revenue through partnerships with [reputable car insurance companies][148]
and agencies. If you request a quote or buy a policy through a partner, the site may receive
compensation at no extra cost to you.

✍️Rankings are based on customer experiences, not referral fees. Start [comparing insurance
quotes][149] now to see rates in 2 minutes or less.

### How long does it take to get car insurance quotes through AutoInsurance.org?

Most users receive quote offers in 2 minutes or less on our site. You enter your information once,
which speeds up the process compared to checking each insurer individually.

⏱️Timing may vary based on how many questions you answer or whether insurers need more details. Read
More: [How to Get an Auto Insurance Quote Without Sharing Personal Information][150].

Enter your ZIP code into our [free quote tool][151] to see available insurers and compare car
insurance prices instantly.

### Does AutoInsurance.org sell car insurance directly?

No. AutoInsurance.org is not an insurance company or agency.

**Auto Accidents**

Every vehicle and driver are required by Texas law to be covered by insurance. This is in place so
that if you are hurt in an auto accident that wasn’t your fault, you can claim compensation from the
responsible driver’s insurance for things like:
* Past and Future Medical Bills,
* Pain and Suffering,
* Lost Wages,
* Property Damage,
* Mental Anguish,
* Wrongful Death,
* And More.

Auto accidents affect innocent victims across Texas every day, caused by stupid mistakes like:
* Failure to yield at an intersection,
* Texting while driving,
* Drunk drivers/driving under the influence,
* Fatigued drivers,
* And reckless driving.

You should never have to pay for an auto accident that wasn’t your fault. If you were injured in a
[Texas auto accident][24], call Shaw at **800-862-1260** today.

**Trucking Accidents**

Passenger vehicles don’t stand a chance against the immense size and weight of large trucks and
18-wheelers – as a result, victims in smaller vehicles often suffer catastrophic injuries.

18-wheeler and large truck accidents are almost always the result of the negligence of the truck
driver or trucking company. Truck drivers must not only follow the rules of the road but also obey
special rules developed by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) and Texas
regulatory authorities. In some cases, you can hold a truck driver negligent per se (negligent as a
matter of law) if they violated a regulation.

For example, trucking companies must perform thorough background checks and properly train
employees. They must regularly check logs to ensure their drivers are adhering to regulations. They
cannot pressure them to take unsafe action, violate regulations, or drive recklessly to meet
deadlines.

Unfortunately, trucking companies have perpetrated these reprehensible actions for years, putting
you and other innocent victims at risk.

You need help if you’re going to stand against the might of a trucking company. If you were hurt in
a [trucking or 18-wheeler accident in Texas][25], call Shaw at **800-862-1260**.

**Motorcycle Accidents**

Motorcyclists face a greater risk of serious injuries than other motorists in an accident.

Unfortunately, there are social stigmas against motorcyclists in Texas. Drivers often don’t accept
that motorcyclists have the same rights and privileges as other drivers on the roads. Even insurance
companies have been known to try to find the motorcyclist at fault to lessen the value of the claim.

If you were hit by another motorist while riding your [motorcycle in Texas][26], call Shaw at
**800-862-1260** to ensure that fault stays where it belongs.

**Commercial and Company Vehicle Accidents**

More and more company vehicles are flooding the roads of Texas, putting drivers at risk.

If you were injured by a company vehicle (a.k.a., a commercial vehicle), the legal process is
slightly more complicated than in a normal accident. Compensation may come from multiple parties,
including:
* The driver,
* The company,
* Vehicle maintenance companies,
* Third-party acquisition companies,
* And others.

Commercial vehicle companies are required to follow certain regulations that are not necessary for
other drivers. For example, companies must perform thorough background checks and properly train
their employees. They cannot pressure them to take unsafe actions like speeding to meet deadlines or
taking phone calls while driving.

Going up against a company alone is not recommended. They have entire teams dedicated to defending
them against liability when their drivers cause accidents. You can have a team backing you up too.

Don’t take a reduced settlement for an accident that wasn’t your fault. [Our commercial vehicle
accident attorneys][27] have stood up for innocent victims against commercial companies in Texas for
over 31 years. Call Shaw at **800-862-1260** for your commercial vehicle accident injury.

**Wrongful Death**

Over 3,000 people die in auto accidents across Texas every year.

When you lose a close family member in an accident due to a wrongful act, neglect, carelessness, or
unskillfulness of someone else, Texas law allows you to bring a wrongful death claim. Family members
who qualify to bring a wrongful death claim include:
* Husbands/wives,
* Children,
* And Parents.

You are allowed to bring this claim, individually or as a family, even if the perpetrator faces a
criminal trial for the accident.

Gaining financial compensation for your loss won’t make you whole again. But you deserve justice and
the peace of mind that comes from knowing the perpetrator who took your family from you was held
responsible.

If your loved one was killed in an accident in Texas, call Shaw’s [Wrongful Death attorneys][28] for
immediate legal assistance at **800-862-1260**.

**Worksite Accidents**

Workplace injuries in Texas can be complicated.

Usually, if you are injured at work, you would need to file a Worker’s Compensation Claim under the
Texas Workers’ Compensation Act. However, not all employers in Texas have Worker’s Compensation
Coverage.

If you were injured at work and your employer has Worker’s Compensation Coverage, our attorneys can
[help you file your claim][29] and negotiate on your behalf. Call Shaw at **800-862-1260** to get
started.

If your employer does not carry Worker’s Compensation Coverage, then you must file a personal injury
claim against them, similar to if you had been injured in an auto accident. Our personal injury
attorneys can offer free legal advice on your best option and help you file your claim. Call Shaw at
**800-862-1260** to get started today.

Additionally, workplace injuries are not always the fault of the employer. This is especially true
in construction work. Injuries may be the combined fault of many parties, including:
* Other workers,
* Employers,
* Contractors,
* Subcontractors,
* Suppliers,
* Equipment manufacturers,
* And developers.

In such cases, having an experienced workplace injury attorney on your side is a critical tool in
securing compensation. Carabin Shaw’s law firm has access to extensive resources to conduct thorough
investigations and is well-versed in the law to secure maximum compensation for our clients.

If you were injured at work in Texas, call Shaw at **800-862-1260** for immediate assistance today.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

Group Health Insurance
Risk Factor

One of the main factors in attracting and retaining good employees is the benefit program offered by
employers. This typically starts with your group health insurance plan.

Solution

Regardless of the company’s financials, there are ways to make health insurance available to your
employees and their dependents. Offering health insurance doesn’t have to break the bank. There are
many solutions available to small, mid-size, and large employers.

Group Life Insurance
Risk Factor

When employees are worried about their financial situation, they may not be as productive. Many
individuals today do not have life insurance or adequate savings to cover final expenses, which
places additional stress on employees and/or their families when the need arises.

Solution

A group life insurance plan can put your employees’ minds at ease, knowing their family will have
resources available when they need them. Policies can also include a dependent benefit to help the
employee pay for expenses if their dependent passes. Another solution is to offer a voluntary life
benefit whereby the employee pays a lower premium through payroll deduction than they would if they
found coverage on their own. Group life insurance is also tax deductible.

Disability
Risk Factor

Many employers are faced with offering lower wages than their competitors and find it difficult to
find and retain qualified workers.

Solution

Offering a short-term and/or a long-term disability program can provide prospective and current
workers with another form of financial stability. An employee may be offered a higher wage
elsewhere, but are they offered protection if that paycheck stops due to pregnancy, illness, or
other disability? How will they pay the mortgage or other bills? Employers offering a disability
plan can provide peace of mind to their employees and gain an advantage over those that don’t.

Risk Factor

Risk Factor

cost-effective way to provide a variety of benefits at little or no impact to your monthly premiums.

* Critical illness, hospital indemnity, and cancer coverage.
* Life, dependent life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage.
* Dental care.
* Vision care.

documents and paperwork at your fingertips should you receive an audit letter?

Solution

A good benefits broker will educate you on the compliance pieces so that you are prepared for that
dreaded day. A wrap document covers most of what is required and the remaining forms should be
readily accessible with proof of distribution to employees and/or eligible participants.

# Click it. Read it. Cover it.

### Get a glimpse of the risks you face and how your insurance can protect what matters most.

[Employee Benefits]
Group Health Insurance
Risk Factor

One of the main factors in attracting and retaining good employees is the benefit program offered by
employers. This typically starts with your group health insurance plan.

Solution

Regardless of the company’s financials, there are ways to make health insurance available to your
employees and their dependents. Offering health insurance doesn’t have to break the bank. There are
many solutions available to small, mid-size, and large employers.

Group Life Insurance
Risk Factor

When employees are worried about their financial situation, they may not be as productive. Many
individuals today do not have life insurance or adequate savings to cover final expenses, which
places additional stress on employees and/or their families when the need arises.

Solution

A group life insurance plan can put your employees’ minds at ease, knowing their family will have
resources available when they need them. Policies can also include a dependent benefit to help the
employee pay for expenses if their dependent passes. Another solution is to offer a voluntary life
benefit whereby the employee pays a lower premium through payroll deduction than they would if they
found coverage on their own. Group life insurance is also tax deductible.

Disability
Risk Factor

Many employers are faced with offering lower wages than their competitors and find it difficult to
find and retain qualified workers.

Solution

Offering a short-term and/or a long-term disability program can provide prospective and current
workers with another form of financial stability. An employee may be offered a higher wage
elsewhere, but are they offered protection if that paycheck stops due to pregnancy, illness, or
other disability? How will they pay the mortgage or other bills? Employers offering a disability
plan can provide peace of mind to their employees and gain an advantage over those that don’t.

Group Dental Coverage
Risk Factor

Failure to have regular dental checkups can lead to more serious problems than a toothache.

Solution

Offering dental coverage to your employees can help encourage them to see a dentist on a regular
basis. Gum disease has been linked to heart disease as well as diabetes. Catching these issues early
not only helps your employees’ health, it may help reduce your long-term health insurance costs
before a big claim hits!

Vision Care Coverage
Risk Factor

Similar to dental coverage, if your employees are not getting regular eye exams, they may have
underlying medical conditions such as heart disease or diabetes that can surface later at a greater
expense to your medical plan.

Solution

Offering vision care coverage is a very affordable component to offering health benefits. It’s an
inexpensive portion of the benefit package with a high value of return and can help offset the
impact of increased medical costs, becoming a cost-effective, early intervention tool.

Voluntary Coverage
Risk Factor

Not being able to meet an employee’s individual needs can pose a threat to worker retention and
attracting new talent, both of which can be costly to your bottom line.

Solution

Offering voluntary coverage lets your employees choose benefits that are important to them. It’s a
cost-effective way to provide a variety of benefits at little or no impact to your monthly premiums.
Examples of voluntary coverage include:
* Critical illness, hospital indemnity, and cancer coverage.
* Life, dependent life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage.
* Dental care.
* Vision care.

Compliance Audits
Risk Factor

Compliance audits are increasing and Department of Labor fines can be costly. Do you have all of the
documents and paperwork at your fingertips should you receive an audit letter?

Solution

A good benefits broker will educate you on the compliance pieces so that you are prepared for that
dreaded day. A wrap document covers most of what is required and the remaining forms should be
readily accessible with proof of distribution to employees and/or eligible participants.

[Reward Yourself Checking][40]

With Reward Yourself Checking, earn unlimited rewards points faster plus enjoy loan discounts,
appraisal credits, and more valuable member perks.

[A teenager holding her debit card while online shopping.]
[SMARTStart Checking][41]

Members 13-25 years old: Open a free SMARTStart Checking Account, receive up to $250 in incentives,
earn rewards on debit card purchases, and level up your money skills. It’s the smart start to
spending!

[A women handing a grocer her debit card.]
[SMARTPay Checking][42]

SMARTPay Checking offers free, hassle-free banking with no fees, unlimited debit card rewards, and
24/7 access to online tools, mobile banking, bill pay, and more.

[A woman in a blazer holding up her debit card.]
[Debit Cards][43]

Use your Visa debit card for purchases, ATM cash, or recurring payments—anywhere Visa is accepted.
Earn rewards and build savings automatically with Round Up Rewards deposits into your Gold Account.

[A women putting money into her piggy bank.]
[Savings][44]

Open a no-fee Share Savings Account with as little as $5. Earn dividends, enjoy easy access to
funds, and make deposits, transfers, and withdrawals anytime.

[A gold piggy bank in a sea of pink piggy banks.]
[Gold Account][45]

The Gold Account is a free, high-yield savings account funded by member loyalty programs and special
offer. Enjoy access to funds whenever you like, while earning great returns.

[A sprout growing out of a jar of coins]
[Certificates][46]

Certificates provide higher dividends than savings accounts with terms from 1 month to 5 years.
Choose Standard or Flex CDs and enjoy an extra 0.25% dividend boost as a President Club member.

[A man talking to a businesswomen.]
[Insured Money Market][47]

The Insured Money Market offers flexible deposits, tiered dividends, no fees, unlimited withdrawals,
and NCUA insurance for secure savings growth.

[A dad helping his son add money to his piggy bank.]
[Kids Club][48]

Kickstart smart saving habits with a free Kids Club Savings Account for ages 12 and under. Open with
just $5, earn dividends, and enjoy anytime access to funds.

[An older couple on the beach staring out at the water.]
[Individual Retirement][49]

An Individual Retirement Account (IRA) can provide a tax-deferred or tax-free way of saving for
retirement.

[A blue piggy bank and a stethoscope.]
[Health Savings][50]

Save on medical expenses with a Goldenwest HSA—tax-deductible contributions, tax-free withdrawals
for qualified expenses, and funds that roll over yearly. Conveniently access your HSA with a Visa
debit card.

[A student holding her backpack.]
[Education Savings][51]

A Coverdell ESA helps you save for a child’s education. Contributions grow tax-free and can be used
for qualified K–12 and college expenses.

[A dog in a Santa hat laying in an open suitcase under the Christmas tree.]
[Christmas Club][52]

Save year-round for the holidays with a Christmas Club Account. Earn dividends and access funds on
November 1st. Deposit anytime via payroll, direct deposit, transfers, or in person.

[Newly wedded couple sitting on a bench.]
[Matrimoney][53]

The Matrimoney account offers a secure, easy way for loved ones to give wedding cash gifts. Open at
any Goldenwest branch or online. Perfect for brides and grooms!

[A woman with a credit card pondering finances]
[Checking][54]

Business checking solutions from Goldenwest designed to fit every size—simple, secure, and tailored
to help your business grow.

[Savings][55]

Earn competitive dividends on your NCUA-insured business savings with easy access online, on our
app, or at any Goldenwest branch.

[Certificates][56]

Business CDs are a smart way to grow your funds—earn more with a 0.25% rate bump when paired with
Business Reward Yourself Checking.

* What's the difference between travel insurance and cancellation insurance?

## Why choose ICICI Lombard?

### Dependable

**You can rely on us at all times.**

Be it during large calamities like Odisha cyclone or minor accidents like a broken tail-light, we
have always stood by our customers in time of need. We have repeatedly introduced industry-leading
practices for nearly two decades . So, in times of trouble, be assured, we’ve got your back. We
stand by our motto: **“Nibhaye Vaade”.**

### Approachable

**You've got a friend in us.**

Value of insurance is realised when you make a claim. In your hour of need, be it a major surgery or
a broken car, you need more than just claim support. Our team comprises highly trained professionals
and functional experts to guide you through the right course of action during emergencies. So, don’t
hesitate. Any questions you have or any help you need - just reach out to us.

from pre-sales to claims support.

## PMFBY

The PMFBY was launched in 2016 and replaces all the prevailing yield insurance schemes in India. The
scheme has extended coverage under localized risks, post-harvest losses etc. and aims at adoption of
technology for the purpose of yield estimation. Through increased farmer awareness and low farmer
premium rates the scheme aims at increasing the crop insurance penetration in India.

## We’ve taken the work out of getting workers comp insurance.

Buying Workers Compensation insurance is mandatory in most states. But it shouldn’t be complicated
and time-consuming. So, we digitized the process bolstered by real, live support: Behind our digital
platform are 50 years of Workers Comp underwriting experience and licensed insurance agents – not
BOTS – who specialize in Workers Comp solutions. Our experienced agents will find you the best
product from A.M. Best “A” rated carriers that fits your needs, helps you control costs and provides
you with unrivaled claims support.

No matter what industry you’re in, the size and scope of your operation or where you’re located,
just fill out the online quote form and our agents will do all the work for you.

## **Why Choose Insure My Work Comp**

Tell Us About Your Business
With Our Simplified Quote Form

A Licensed Agent Will Review Your App & Call You to Provide the Best Coverage & Price

You’ll Receive A Free Quote,
No Commitment Required

## Learn the INS & OUTS of workers comp

What is Workers Comp Insurance?

Workers Compensation insurance, also known as Workman’s Comp and Work Comp, is mandatory in the
majority of states. Employers purchase a Workers Comp policy to provide employees with coverage for
medical expenses and rehabilitation costs in the event of on-the-job injuries or illnesses. If an
employee misses work because of a job-related injury or illness, Workers’ Comp can also provide
partial lost wages. In most situations, injured employees receive coverage no matter who was at
fault for the injury, and preclude workers from suing employers for the injuries
covered.

Bottom line: Workers Comp insurance protects your business’ assets by shielding you from potential
lawsuits, while providing injured employees with medical care and compensation for lost wages.

Who’s Covered?

Each state establishes its own parameters about when an employer must acquire Workers Comp coverage.

## Three steps to insure your business

View video transcript.
**I. Leadership roundtable discussion introduction**

**JENNY RUNDE, SENIOR VP PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT:** Insureon is the largest provider of small business
insurance online. We make it easy for small business owners to come to our site and find coverage
for their businesses. They can come to our website, fill out a single application, and get quotes
back in seconds from all of the top carriers. And at that point, they're in the hands of our our
insurance agents who can walk them through all their questions, all of their concerns and make sure
that they've got the coverage that they need.

**II. How do our experts ensure you get what you need?**

**KARI ALLEN, VP SALES:** We have best-in-class sales producers who are dedicated to small market.
They specialize in the micro businesses and focus completely on what are the needs of the small
business client, what questions might they have, and where to direct them to help them understand
coverages. We found that over 90% of small business customers don't understand the coverage
insurance that they need, so their job is to help them understand what they need, and how to get
that coverage in place. And so they walk them through as their trusted advisor.

**III. What do we deliver long-term for small business owners?**

**DY KUNKEL, VP ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT:** After the producers write the coverage for the clients, then
it transfers over to our account management team, which our account management team's goal is to
provide ease to the customers and retain their business. Our customers are really busy as business
owners trying to run their small business, so it's our job to make their lives easier and provide
them with that comfort and support of giving them the insurance that they need for their business.

**IV. What added value comes along with that?**

**JENNIFER CROMLY, DIRECTOR SALES, OPERATIONS, ANALYTICS:** We provide value because we are an
insurance agency that works with small business owners all over the country. And in doing so, we
provide the business owner the autonomy to be able to provide us their information on their
timetable.

We have such strong relationships with all of our carriers and our experienced producers so that
wherever that small business owner is located, we have a carrier that is going to provide the most
competitive coverage and the most comprehensive coverage, and we're then going to be able to
maintain this relationship with the small business owner throughout their growth and changes as they
also develop as a small business owner. I think as a small business owner there is so much
responsibility that they have, and protecting their business from loss is one of the largest
exposures that they have, and it's our privilege to be able to work with them.

**V. What insurance companies can you choose from?**

**MAURA BENSON, DIRECTOR CARRIER RELATIONSHIPS:** We partner with A+ rated carriers in order to
accommodate many different types of small business owners and and what they're doing. Anything from
lawn care and accounting, to restaurants and IT Consultants. By establishing these strong
relationships, we're able to provide competitive rates as well as have a good understanding of the
service center capabilities and just being able to give our clients the the best options available
in the market.

**VI. How do small business owners find us?**

**YULIA KRONROD, SENIOR VP CUSTOMER ACQUISITION:** Most customers find us through Google, but the
way they search for information varies greatly. Some people search for their profession and how they
can protect their type of business with insurance, others search for policy type. Yet, others just
simply ask a question "Do I need insurance at all?" or "How do I renew my policy?" and things like
that, so we try to educate customers on all those types of queries that they ask in Google or other
search engines. We have information around what type of policies you need if you run this type of
business, what a specific type of policy covers, we have educational articles for them on how to
start and develop their business into something viable that they can succeed with, and things like
that.

**VII. What are we doing to make it easy for small business owners to buy insurance?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** We know that many of our customers are a brand new business or new to buying
business insurance, and so it can be a really stressful decision to make and one of the first things
we try to do on our site is really educate people. Give them all the articles and the blogs and the
information that's going to help educate them and inform them on what they need and what their
options are. We also have the ability through technology to actually recommend products to them so
have them answer a few simple questions about their business, and in seconds basically can recommend
the types of insurance that they might need to cover their businesses.

So once they're at a point where they feel fairly comfortable with the types of insurance that they
might need, and they've got some of those questions answered, then it's really our goal to make that
process as seamless as possible in filling out the application. So from there they can select their
profession type, they fill out a simple application online, and in the seconds they're able to get
prices that are real time prices with all of the best carriers.

**KARI ALLEN:** By the time the application comes in and they compare coverages and they've either
selected to go with certain carrier it's our producer's job to take a look at everything they put
in, make sure that that makes sense, and then reach out to the customer and interact with them the
way they want to be interacted with, whether that's text, whether that's phone, or whether that's
email. And what they do is really review the coverages that they put together and you say "Does this
make sense? What state is it in? Are our producers are licensed in every state? What carrier's
actions do they have? Have they chosen a carrier that makes sense for their needs?"

And I think, to put a bow on it, obviously in insurance and potential insurance, that small business
customers are going to have questions, and we can interact with these customers again how they want
to be interacted with, but they're going to have questions about "What is covered? What isn't
covered? How do I file a claim? What are some things that I need to be aware of as I'm issuing the
policies?" And that's what our people are there for that to make sure that we put the customer and
small business customers needs first and make sure that they are covered and, you know, set their
mind at ease.

**DY KUNKEL:** After our clients have selected coverage through Kari's team, then they have the
ability to go on and review that coverage again on our customer portal. Our customer portal also
offers them the ability to look back at policies they've had previously, make changes to their
current policies, request endorsements if they need to on that coverage. They can also get a
certificate of insurance that shows proof of their coverage that they do have today. They can review
which carriers they're with, as well, and the pricing of the coverage they have currently. And they
can also find their insurance agent to get in contact with them, all by using our customer portal.

**VIII. Where and when are we talking to customers?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** Small business owners are...they're busy people. They're not always in front of
their desk, right? They're growing their businesses, they're working with customers, they're out in
the field. And so we know as an organization that we have to meet them where they are. And we have
to be available when they are. And so for us, we really think very often about mobile as a key
channel for our customers. So many of our customers come to us via their mobile devices, right? They
could be could be late at night after leaving a job site, and that's the only time that they have to
be able to search for insurance, and so that's where we really focus on our website of being
optimized for that mobile experience so that it is as easy for them to buy insurance via their
mobile device or their desktop as it would be walking into a brick and mortar.

**DY KUNKEL, VP ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT:** After the producers write the coverage for the clients, then
it transfers over to our account management team, which our account management team's goal is to
provide ease to the customers and retain their business. Our customers are really busy as business
owners trying to run their small business, so it's our job to make their lives easier and provide
them with that comfort and support of giving them the insurance that they need for their business.

**IV. What added value comes along with that?**

**JENNIFER CROMLY, DIRECTOR SALES, OPERATIONS, ANALYTICS:** We provide value because we are an
insurance agency that works with small business owners all over the country. And in doing so, we
provide the business owner the autonomy to be able to provide us their information on their
timetable.

We have such strong relationships with all of our carriers and our experienced producers so that
wherever that small business owner is located, we have a carrier that is going to provide the most
competitive coverage and the most comprehensive coverage, and we're then going to be able to
maintain this relationship with the small business owner throughout their growth and changes as they
also develop as a small business owner. I think as a small business owner there is so much
responsibility that they have, and protecting their business from loss is one of the largest
exposures that they have, and it's our privilege to be able to work with them.

**V. What insurance companies can you choose from?**

**MAURA BENSON, DIRECTOR CARRIER RELATIONSHIPS:** We partner with A+ rated carriers in order to
accommodate many different types of small business owners and and what they're doing. Anything from
lawn care and accounting, to restaurants and IT Consultants. By establishing these strong
relationships, we're able to provide competitive rates as well as have a good understanding of the
service center capabilities and just being able to give our clients the the best options available
in the market.

**VI. How do small business owners find us?**

**YULIA KRONROD, SENIOR VP CUSTOMER ACQUISITION:** Most customers find us through Google, but the
way they search for information varies greatly. Some people search for their profession and how they
can protect their type of business with insurance, others search for policy type. Yet, others just
simply ask a question "Do I need insurance at all?" or "How do I renew my policy?" and things like
that, so we try to educate customers on all those types of queries that they ask in Google or other
search engines. We have information around what type of policies you need if you run this type of
business, what a specific type of policy covers, we have educational articles for them on how to
start and develop their business into something viable that they can succeed with, and things like
that.

**VII. What are we doing to make it easy for small business owners to buy insurance?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** We know that many of our customers are a brand new business or new to buying
business insurance, and so it can be a really stressful decision to make and one of the first things
we try to do on our site is really educate people. Give them all the articles and the blogs and the
information that's going to help educate them and inform them on what they need and what their
options are. We also have the ability through technology to actually recommend products to them so
have them answer a few simple questions about their business, and in seconds basically can recommend
the types of insurance that they might need to cover their businesses.

So once they're at a point where they feel fairly comfortable with the types of insurance that they
might need, and they've got some of those questions answered, then it's really our goal to make that
process as seamless as possible in filling out the application. So from there they can select their
profession type, they fill out a simple application online, and in the seconds they're able to get
prices that are real time prices with all of the best carriers.

**KARI ALLEN:** By the time the application comes in and they compare coverages and they've either
selected to go with certain carrier it's our producer's job to take a look at everything they put
in, make sure that that makes sense, and then reach out to the customer and interact with them the
way they want to be interacted with, whether that's text, whether that's phone, or whether that's
email. And what they do is really review the coverages that they put together and you say "Does this
make sense? What state is it in? Are our producers are licensed in every state? What carrier's
actions do they have? Have they chosen a carrier that makes sense for their needs?"

And I think, to put a bow on it, obviously in insurance and potential insurance, that small business
customers are going to have questions, and we can interact with these customers again how they want
to be interacted with, but they're going to have questions about "What is covered? What isn't
covered? How do I file a claim? What are some things that I need to be aware of as I'm issuing the
policies?" And that's what our people are there for that to make sure that we put the customer and
small business customers needs first and make sure that they are covered and, you know, set their
mind at ease.

**DY KUNKEL:** After our clients have selected coverage through Kari's team, then they have the
ability to go on and review that coverage again on our customer portal. Our customer portal also
offers them the ability to look back at policies they've had previously, make changes to their
current policies, request endorsements if they need to on that coverage. They can also get a
certificate of insurance that shows proof of their coverage that they do have today. They can review
which carriers they're with, as well, and the pricing of the coverage they have currently. And they
can also find their insurance agent to get in contact with them, all by using our customer portal.

**VIII. Where and when are we talking to customers?**

**JENNY RUNDE:** Small business owners are...they're busy people. They're not always in front of
their desk, right? They're growing their businesses, they're working with customers, they're out in
the field. And so we know as an organization that we have to meet them where they are. And we have
to be available when they are. And so for us, we really think very often about mobile as a key
channel for our customers. So many of our customers come to us via their mobile devices, right? They
could be could be late at night after leaving a job site, and that's the only time that they have to
be able to search for insurance, and so that's where we really focus on our website of being
optimized for that mobile experience so that it is as easy for them to buy insurance via their
mobile device or their desktop as it would be walking into a brick and mortar.

Massachusetts and beyond for four generations, we remain steadfast in our commitment to our clients.

* Put our clients’ needs first.
* Offer access to a broad range of carriers.
* Provide competitive pricing and customized coverage.
* Deliver exceptional customer service without corporate interference.

By staying independent, we ensure that our clients always come first—just as they have for over 100
years.

How to choose the Best

## Personal Injury Attorney in Tampa Bay

There is no shortage of personal injury attorneys in Tampa Bay, but when you’ve been injured in an
accident it’s important to find one that works for you. Here’s four things to look for when picking
the right personal injury attorney for your case. 

1 

Areas of Expertise

You don’t want to just have an attorney who is generally qualified. You want to make sure that the
accident attorney you hire is specifically qualified to handle your case. At The Fran Haasch Law
Group, we have over 25 years of experience in various personal injury cases from car and motorcycle
accidents to catastrophic injuries.

2

Potential Costs

We operate on a contingency fee. This means that no money is paid upfront. Instead, injured clients
who need access to legal counsel, but have no funds to pay for a personal injury lawyer, can still
receive essential legal assistance when they need it most. Lawyers collect payment as a percentage
of a successful settlement.

3

The Legal Team

A personal injury law firm is more than a single lawyer. The best law firms have a team behind them
that are also ready to fight for your case. At The Fran Haasch Law Group, our entire team of car and
motorcycle accident attorneys is committed to helping you get the compensation you deserve.

4

Communication

How does the personal injury lawyer communicate with their clients? How will you get in touch with

# We are Liberty

We are Liberty International Insurance, a division of the Liberty Mutual Insurance Group.

[Learn more ][6]
[Statue of liberty]

Liberty International Insurance represents Liberty Mutual’s commercial, specialty, and personal
lines business outside North America. This business trades under two main brands, [Liberty Specialty
Markets][7] across Europe, UK & MENA and LatAm and Liberty across Asia Pacific. 

Through leveraging the financial strength, robust capabilities and high-performance culture of
Liberty Mutual Group, we optimise our operations, bringing consistency and geographic reach.

Our focus is to deliver the advantages of a global business, while enabling local decision-making in
our local markets, ensuring optimal benefits for our brokers and clients.

# Loggers Broad Form Insurance and more...

#### Loggers Broad Form Insurance from Athena Insurance since 1996. Steve Valencia Broker

# We're experts

You have come to the correct web site if you are seeking a dedicated licensed agent and broker.
Athena Insurance and Financial Services has been servicing insured's needs since 1996 with
everything from life insurance to loggers broad form insurance.  Experience matters!

##### **Loggers Broad form third party fire suppression liability****
##### **

We offer Loggers Broad Form Liabilitin on a stand-alone basis. Please understand, you are required
to “have” General Liability to obtain Loggers Broad Form. 

We can provide you with both Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. But, if you already have
General Liability we will “consider” writing the Loggers Broad Form for your. 

The concern for us is that your General Liability coveres the classes of opertaions related to why
you are needing the loggers broad form. 

We highly recommend having us write both the Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. 

[ Quote Logger Broad Form Now][26]

##### **Inland Marine & logging equipment & misc. tools
##### **

Inland Marine Insurance is available on a “stand-alone” basis for qualified prospects and clients.  

Eligibility will depend on a number of factors such as proof of prior coverage, claim experience
history, number of pieces of equipment, geographic and more. 

What do we need to quote? We need an Inland Marine intake form. You may submit one at your leisure
of call us and we will complete one for you. 

We must have the following: Year Make, model, serial number, current market value and loss payee
name & address.



[ Quote Inland Marine Coverage][27]

##### **Commercial Auto & Transportation
##### **

Single vehicles to fleets. Heavy duty trucks to log haulers we provide services to nearly all States
in the U.S. 

Options may include “Excess” liability, non-owne auto, drive – other car, hire auto and more. 

Personal auto has  exclusions. We will review your current policy and point out the potential
pitt-falls of your current coverage. 

State and Federal Filings are availble for most operations.  

Additional Insured Certificates and other options may be provided including optional endorsements
such as Waiver of Subrogation and Primay Wording. 



[ Quote Commercial Auto now][28]

[ Who do we Quote? Click here][29]

### We are here to help you meet and exceed your insurance needs.

# Loggers Broad Form Insurance and more...

#### Loggers Broad Form Insurance from Athena Insurance since 1996. Steve Valencia Broker

# We're experts

You have come to the correct web site if you are seeking a dedicated licensed agent and broker.
Athena Insurance and Financial Services has been servicing insured's needs since 1996 with
everything from life insurance to loggers broad form insurance.  Experience matters!

##### **Loggers Broad form third party fire suppression liability****
##### **

We offer Loggers Broad Form Liabilitin on a stand-alone basis. Please understand, you are required
to “have” General Liability to obtain Loggers Broad Form. 

We can provide you with both Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. But, if you already have
General Liability we will “consider” writing the Loggers Broad Form for your. 

The concern for us is that your General Liability coveres the classes of opertaions related to why
you are needing the loggers broad form. 

We highly recommend having us write both the Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. 

[ Quote Logger Broad Form Now][26]

##### **Inland Marine & logging equipment & misc. tools
##### **

Inland Marine Insurance is available on a “stand-alone” basis for qualified prospects and clients.  

Eligibility will depend on a number of factors such as proof of prior coverage, claim experience
history, number of pieces of equipment, geographic and more. 

What do we need to quote? We need an Inland Marine intake form. You may submit one at your leisure
of call us and we will complete one for you. 

We must have the following: Year Make, model, serial number, current market value and loss payee
name & address.



[ Quote Inland Marine Coverage][27]

##### **Commercial Auto & Transportation
##### **

Single vehicles to fleets. Heavy duty trucks to log haulers we provide services to nearly all States
in the U.S. 

Options may include “Excess” liability, non-owne auto, drive – other car, hire auto and more. 

Personal auto has  exclusions. We will review your current policy and point out the potential
pitt-falls of your current coverage. 

State and Federal Filings are availble for most operations.  

Additional Insured Certificates and other options may be provided including optional endorsements
such as Waiver of Subrogation and Primay Wording. 



[ Quote Commercial Auto now][28]

##### we insure the timber industry

We hope to become your one stop shop for all of you insurance needs.  

[ Who do we Quote? Click here][29]

### We are here to help you meet and exceed your insurance needs. 

Insurance Broker Steve Valencia. #0588228 / National Producer #2709340

### We’re a long-established partner in the property and casualty market.

We are the US-based subsidiary of MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc., one of the world’s top P&C
carriers, with A+, Class 15 ratings and a reach that spans 40+ countries and regions. Our 350-year
heritage is a testament to our strength, stability, and commitment to helping protect leading
businesses around the globe.

[mask image]

## You expect your commercial insurance partner to provide more than a policy. We agree.

We make it our business to understand your business, allowing us to solve your unique risk
issues—including the most complex—with coverage that is customized to the way you do business. We
complement your insurance with services that help you reduce risk, prevent losses, monitor your
claims and loss activity, and achieve an effective and timely resolution. Through it all, our
dedicated support team delivers the superior service experience your
business deserves.

[View Our Risk Engineering Services >][121]

Some of the most innovative businesses face new and challenging risks, including the renewable
energy businesses which are creating novel solutions to address climate change and protecting our
planet. MSIG USA is committed to addressing emerging risks with creative insurance solutions.

your message to multiple companies at once.

and affordable. Our flexible programs include Pay-As-You-Go, PayGo, Direct Insured, Multi-State, and

## Fast and Affordable Workers’ Comp Insurance

Obtaining workers compensation insurance is complicated. Most carriers shy away from staffing, due
factors unique to the industry (higher claim rate, dynamic payrolls, and uncertainty of job duties).
As a result, it often takes weeks, if not months, to find a policy, especially your company was
non-renewed from your prior carrier. As our focus is staffing, we know where to find the most
competitive rates and programs tailored to agencies like yours.

[Get Started][56]

[mbl img workers - Home][mbl img workers - Home]

## Flexible Plans and Options to Meet the Needs of Your Staffing Agency

Every staffing agency operates differently, which is why we offer a wide range of flexible programs.
Our options include Pay-As-You-Go (PayGo), Direct Insured, Multi-State coverage, PEO solutions, and
more. Many of these plans require little or no money down, with no contracts and no audits, giving
your agency the freedom to scale without extra hurdles. Whether you’re a startup with two employees
or an established agency with workers nationwide, we’ll connect you with the right coverage. We also
help international staffing firms secure workers’ comp for US-based employees.

[Get Your Workers Insured Today][57]
