# Payroll and Employer Solutions

[[Payroll Services]][40]

### Payroll Services

Cloud-powered solutions that are straightforward, scalable and designed to each client’s
specifications by a team of dedicated payroll pros.

[[HR /HR Services]][41]

### HR Services

Complete personnel management including talent acquisition, employee relations, audits, compliance,
policy development, and consultations.

[[Insurance Services]][42]

### Insurance Services

Extensive selection of employee benefits with seamless enrollment and payroll integration for a
streamlined experience combined with maximum value.

[[Retirement Plan Services]][43]

### Retirement Plan Services

Comprehensive solutions designed with complete payroll integration, easy administration, and expert
support to help ensure employees’ financial future.

## **Our Clients**

[Network]

### **Partners**

Seamlessly offer our services to clients under your own brand, giving you the ability to provide
comprehensive, hassle-free payroll solutions without the overhead. Our user-friendly platform,
compliance expertise, wide range of customized solutions, and dedicated support ensure your clients
receive reliable payroll management while you enhance value and grow your business.

[Links2]

### **Associations**

Our solutions empower associations to better support your member community. We provide targeted,
efficient processes and cost-effective services to help maximize the resources you provide. With our
support, you can focus on expanding member benefits, creating added value and fostering the growth
and success of the professionals, businesses and employees you serve.

[Puzzle]

### **Businesses**

Our services are designed to simplify and streamline business operations. With intuitive technology,
expert compliance support, and a dedicated team, we ensure accuracy and efficiency. Whether you’re a
small business needing hands-on guidance or a larger company requiring scalability and integration,
our customizable solutions help you save time, reduce errors, and stay compliant.

## **Choose Your Custom Payroll Solution**

### Payentry Payroll

From start-ups to established businesses with payroll and tax needs.

Work directly with a payroll professional to discuss and design the perfect solution for your
business.

[Our Payentry Payroll primary solution includes:][44]
* Dedicated Client Advocate
* Unlimited Payroll Processing
* Unlimited Local, State & Federal Tax Filings
* Unlimited New Hire Reporting
* Unlimited Direct Deposit
* Employee Self Service & Mobile Application
* Garnishments & Agency Payments
* Paperless End-of-Year Forms – 1099s & W2s
* Scalable Custom Reporting
* PTO, Vacation & Accrual Tracking
[Let’s Talk][45]

### Payentry Comprehensive

For businesses with advanced payroll, HR, compliance and reporting needs.

Work directly with payroll and HR professionals to design the perfect solution for your business.

[Includes all of the services in our Payroll plan plus:][46]
* Dedicated Client Advocate
* Hire & Onboarding Modules
* WOTC Screening
* Time Management
* Job Costing & Labor Distribution
* HR Answers
* Certified Payroll Reports
* QBO & GL Reports
* Labor Law Posters
* Additional Add-Ons Available
[Let’s Talk][47]

### Payentry Comprehensive+

For businesses with more complex payroll, HR, compliance and benefit enrollment needs.

Work directly with our team of payroll, HR and benefits professionals to design the perfect solution
for your business.

**PMC Insurance Group – Acquisition Announcement**

We at PMC Insurance Group are excited to share that we have joined One80 Intermediaries.

One80 is a privately held wholesaler and program manager based in Boston, MA. With over 35 offices
throughout the US and Canada, One80 offers placement services and binding authority for property &
casualty, financial lines, personal lines, cannabis, life insurance, medical stop loss, alternative
risk, warranty, lender-based insurance, travel/accident and health risks. One80 serves commercial
companies, non-profits, public entities, and individuals, and has access to all major insurance
markets in the US, Canada and UK.

We have a longstanding relationship with the One80 team and have been extremely impressed with the
culture and opportunities available throughout the organization. The One80 partnership will allow us
to expand our expertise, offerings and capacity for casualty, professional lines, personal lines,
travel/accident, health and more.

With that said, the leadership team and employees at PMC will remain unchanged; and we will continue
to provide you with the same customized, market-leading Workers’ Compensation products and services
as we have for over 25 years.

We plan to announce this transaction in the next coming weeks. At that time, you will find that our
branding will be updated to include the One80 logo. However, the team remains committed to providing
you with our outstanding level of service and market leading expertise as we grow together.

Should you have any questions please contact the PMC team directly. We thank you for entrusting us
with your business and look forward to supporting you and your clients, helping your business grow
in the coming years!

Kind Regards,

[David Malloy][98] and [Andrew Shaw][99]

Managing Directors

**PMC Insurance Group, a division of One80 Intermediaries**

discounts. Plus, you can get a quote in just a few minutes – get started now and enjoy peace of mind

**Why Progressive?:** We guarantee repairs for as long as you own or lease your vehicle when you

#### Bundle property and save an average of 5% on auto in most states!^{Δ}

Simply quote auto and homeowners insurance and you could earn a multi-policy discount.^{Δ} Plus,

[Learn more about bundling][33]

#### Quote now & get covered for as low as $100/year^{**}

With Progressive, you can take your boat to any lake or river, plus ocean waters within 75 miles of
the coast. And we offer a variety of coverages to protect your boat and the good times that come
with it. Quote now to get started.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and
more, you can float on without worry.

[Learn more about boat][34]

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][36]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

[Learn more about commercial auto][37]

#### Cover yourself for everything your condo association doesn't

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you
can be covered for theft, damage, and more. Get a quote today for greater peace of mind.

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

#### Ride with the #1 bike insurer starting at $75/year^{§}

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][42]

#### Pet insurance

Affordable coverage for your four-legged friend

With Progressive Pet Insurance by Pets Best, you can create a plan that fits your dog or cat's
needs, as well as your budget. Simply choose a plan and then customize your deductible,
reimbursement percentage, and annual limit.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

#### Protect yourself from damage, theft, and more

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,
or storage locker. Plus, if you can't stay in your residence due to a covered incident, we'll help
pay for your temporary living expenses. Get covered today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

[Learn more about renters][44]

#### Join a leading RV insurer starting at $125/year^{††}

Whether you're a full-time RVer or an occasional road-tripper, you'll find all the coverages you
need at an affordable price right here. Get a quote now and enjoy the open road without worry.

**Why Progressive?:** From windshield & glass coverage to emergency expenses, we have your road trip
covered.

[Learn more about RV][45]

#### Umbrella insurance

Extra coverage for all your assets

Umbrella insurance provides an extra layer of liability coverage beyond what your home and auto
policy offer, with limits available up to $5 million.

[Learn more about umbrella insurance][46]

our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all
repairs.

[Learn more about motorcycle][47]

##  

## FREE INSURANCE RESOURCES

 

[[Download the free ebook about the power of an ESOP for your company]][2]

Employee Stock Ownership Plans represent the future as employees seek opportunities to be part of
something meaningful beyond a paycheck. In this ebook, we discuss our transition to an ESOP and
share tips and strategies for making a successful transition for your company. In this free ebook,
you'll learn about: 
* The tactical, relational, and cultural benefits of implementing an ESOP.
* Tips for maximizing employee performance with your new ESOP.
* Ways to help instill an ownership mentality with your team. 
  

[[Download the ESOP eBook]][3]

[[1617898939___WinterDent_employeebenefits_Page_01-1]][4]

As the competition for quality employees increases, give your business a competitive edge through
your employee benefits package. The right plan will entice quality employees to consider your
business over the competition, and provide them with a reason to stay. In this free ebook, you'll
learn about:
* Benefits that are required (the *must-haves).*
* Benefits that aren't required, but are expected by quality employees (*should-haves*.)
* And finally, you'll see a list of *nice-to-haves* - those benefits that probably won't cost you
  money but turn a good job into a great one. 

[[Download the Employee Benefits Guide]][5]

[[Captives-ebook-square-logo (1)]][6]

When exploring healthcare options for your company, you don't have to be stuck with just the
traditional options. A captive is a cutting-edge way of gaining control over more of your risk and
controlling your cost while still maintaining the same good quality coverage (or better!) as the big
boys.

This free ebook explores captives and helps you determine if they could be a fit for your
business. Here's what's inside:
* What exactly is a captive?
* What are the advantages?
* Who should consider a captive...and more!


[[Download the Captives eBook]][7]

[[A Comprehensive Guide to Captives CTA square]][8]

Many small businesses find that traditional commercial insurance meets their needs, but medium and
larger-size companies often spend too much for too little**.**

**It's nice to know there are options. ****A captive is an excellent choice that operates outside
the framework of existing providers' traditional insurance policies. **

**A captive can make more customized coverage available and financially rewards companies for being
proactive. Established businesses with high insurance premiums may likely find this an advantageous
alternative to traditional insurance.**

**Want to learn more? Check out our comprehensive guide to captives. **

[[Take Me to the Captives Info Page]][9]

[[P&C Captives Ebook Cover -1-1]][10]

Many small businesses find that traditional commercial insurance meets their property and casualty
needs, but medium and larger-size companies often spend too much for too little.

If Property and Casualty premiums seem high, or coverages are unavailable, a captive may be a better
option. A captive can make more customized coverage available, and financially rewards companies for
being proactive. Established businesses with high insurance premiums may likely find this an
advantageous alternative to traditional insurance.

**Want to learn more? **

**Check out our free ebook on property & casualty captives. **

[[Download the P & C Captives eBook]][11]

[[Wonder if your business is right for a captive]][12]

You've may have heard about a captive as an alternative to the traditional insurance marketplace.
With a captive, a business or businesses create an insuring subsidiary that provides an alternative
way to fund future losses - one that they own. Once established, they look like, operate like, and
are regulated like any other insurance company. 

They offer lots of benefits for the right types of businesses. Curious to know whether or not your
business is a fit for a captive? Take this quick self-assessment to find out if your business is a
candidate.

 

 

[[See If Your Business Would Qualify for a Captive]][13]

### [[Youve Experienced a Data Breach ... Now What (Instagram Post (Square))]][14]

In spite of your best proactive efforts, a data breach can still happen. When it does, you'll need
quick, easy access to the steps you can take that will minimize the loss and get you on the road to
recovery. 

This simple downloadable infographic can be printed in poster size and posted or kept in a cyber
recovery file along with the information you'll need to get your business back on track. 

Don't be caught unprepared. Hackers are smart, your goal is to be smarter. That means working to
ensure that it won't happen but planning as if it will.

 

[[Download the Data Breach Infographic]][15]

Stay on top of current trends in the world of insurance. Subscribe to our insurance blog and get the
latest tips and strategies for risk optimization for yourself, your business, and your family.

##  

## FREE INSURANCE RESOURCES

 

[[Download the free ebook about the power of an ESOP for your company]][2]

Employee Stock Ownership Plans represent the future as employees seek opportunities to be part of
something meaningful beyond a paycheck. In this ebook, we discuss our transition to an ESOP and
share tips and strategies for making a successful transition for your company. In this free ebook,
you'll learn about: 
* The tactical, relational, and cultural benefits of implementing an ESOP.
* Tips for maximizing employee performance with your new ESOP.
* Ways to help instill an ownership mentality with your team. 
  

[[Download the ESOP eBook]][3]

[[1617898939___WinterDent_employeebenefits_Page_01-1]][4]

As the competition for quality employees increases, give your business a competitive edge through
your employee benefits package. The right plan will entice quality employees to consider your
business over the competition, and provide them with a reason to stay. In this free ebook, you'll
learn about:
* Benefits that are required (the *must-haves).*
* Benefits that aren't required, but are expected by quality employees (*should-haves*.)
* And finally, you'll see a list of *nice-to-haves* - those benefits that probably won't cost you
  money but turn a good job into a great one. 

[[Download the Employee Benefits Guide]][5]

[[Captives-ebook-square-logo (1)]][6]

When exploring healthcare options for your company, you don't have to be stuck with just the
traditional options. A captive is a cutting-edge way of gaining control over more of your risk and
controlling your cost while still maintaining the same good quality coverage (or better!) as the big
boys.

This free ebook explores captives and helps you determine if they could be a fit for your
business. Here's what's inside:
* What exactly is a captive?
* What are the advantages?
* Who should consider a captive...and more!


[[Download the Captives eBook]][7]

[[A Comprehensive Guide to Captives CTA square]][8]

Many small businesses find that traditional commercial insurance meets their needs, but medium and
larger-size companies often spend too much for too little**.**

**It's nice to know there are options. ****A captive is an excellent choice that operates outside
the framework of existing providers' traditional insurance policies. **

**A captive can make more customized coverage available and financially rewards companies for being
proactive. Established businesses with high insurance premiums may likely find this an advantageous
alternative to traditional insurance.**

**Want to learn more? Check out our comprehensive guide to captives. **

[[Take Me to the Captives Info Page]][9]

[[P&C Captives Ebook Cover -1-1]][10]

Many small businesses find that traditional commercial insurance meets their property and casualty
needs, but medium and larger-size companies often spend too much for too little.

If Property and Casualty premiums seem high, or coverages are unavailable, a captive may be a better
option. A captive can make more customized coverage available, and financially rewards companies for
being proactive. Established businesses with high insurance premiums may likely find this an
advantageous alternative to traditional insurance.

**Want to learn more? **

**Check out our free ebook on property & casualty captives. **

[[Download the P & C Captives eBook]][11]

[[Wonder if your business is right for a captive]][12]

You've may have heard about a captive as an alternative to the traditional insurance marketplace.
With a captive, a business or businesses create an insuring subsidiary that provides an alternative
way to fund future losses - one that they own. Once established, they look like, operate like, and
are regulated like any other insurance company. 

They offer lots of benefits for the right types of businesses. Curious to know whether or not your
business is a fit for a captive? Take this quick self-assessment to find out if your business is a
candidate.

 

 

[[See If Your Business Would Qualify for a Captive]][13]

### [[Youve Experienced a Data Breach ... Now What (Instagram Post (Square))]][14]

In spite of your best proactive efforts, a data breach can still happen. When it does, you'll need
quick, easy access to the steps you can take that will minimize the loss and get you on the road to
recovery. 

This simple downloadable infographic can be printed in poster size and posted or kept in a cyber
recovery file along with the information you'll need to get your business back on track. 

Don't be caught unprepared. Hackers are smart, your goal is to be smarter. That means working to
ensure that it won't happen but planning as if it will.

 

[[Download the Data Breach Infographic]][15]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What should I list as my destination?

You can enter one or multiple destinations when getting a quote. If you are visiting multiple
countries, you can enter each into the “Destinations” field. However, you are only required to enter
one.

It’s important to note that there are a few restricted destinations we do not provide travel
protection for. For this reason, we recommend entering all destinations.

### What does travel insurance from Travel Insured cover?

Travel insurance benefits can provide coverage for losses or expenses incurred while traveling, such
as cancellations, medical emergencies, and more

### Do I need travel insurance?

Some countries may require proof of travel insurance, in which case we hope you choose Travel
Insured International for your trip. For other scenarios where travel insurance is not mandatory, we
still recommend getting a plan especially for travelers who are traveling internationally and may
have significant non-refundable expenses, or want protection against unexpected events like medical
emergencies or trip cancellations. Ultimately, travel insurance can provide peace of mind and some
financial security—helping you to relax just a little bit more.

### How does travel insurance work?

Travel insurance helps protect against unexpected events that may occur before or during your trip,
such as trip cancellations, medical emergencies, or lost luggage. When you purchase a plan, you pay
a cost based on your trip details and coverage needs. If a covered event happens, you file a claim
with us, submit any required documentation, and, if approved, receive reimbursement for your
eligible expenses up to the plan’s maximum benefit amount.

### How much is travel insurance?

The cost of travel protection varies depending on factors such as your trip duration, age, and the
level of coverage you choose. Additional coverage options, such as our Flight Bundle or Cruise
Bundle, are an additional cost to the base plan. Comparing plans and coverage details can help you
find the best value for your specific travel needs.

### Is travel insurance worth it?

Travel protection may be worth it for travelers, particularly when taking international trips or
making significant non-refundable bookings. It offers essential protection against unexpected events
such as medical emergencies, trip cancellations, or lost luggage, which can otherwise be pricey
without reimbursement. Overall, for anyone seeking peace of mind and some financial security while
traveling, purchasing travel protection can be a good choice.

NEW YORK WORKERS’ COMP – HOW TO FILE

# How to file a New York workers’ comp claim.

The forms, telling your employer, choosing an authorized doctor, and what the carrier must do once
you file.

[Start the process][22]

## Filing your claim, step by step

1

### Report to your employer

Notify your employer in writing within 30 days of the injury – this protects your right to benefits.

2

### Get authorized medical care

See a provider authorized by the NY Workers’ Comp Board; the provider files the medical report on
your condition.

3

### File Form C-3

Submit your employee claim to the Board online, by mail or email, or in person – not by telephone.

4

### The carrier responds

The insurer must begin payments or formally dispute the claim, generally within about 18 days of
learning of the injury.

## The forms and players in a NY filing

───────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Form C-3           │Your employee claim, filed with the Workers’ Compensation Board
───────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Written notice     │Given to your employer within 30 days of the injury            
───────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Authorized provider│A Board-authorized doctor who files the medical report         
───────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18-day response    │When the carrier should start paying or controvert             
───────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

NEW YORK WORKERS’ COMP – HOW TO FILE

# How to file a New York workers’ comp claim.

The forms, telling your employer, choosing an authorized doctor, and what the carrier must do once
you file.

[Start the process][22]

## Filing your claim, step by step

1

### Report to your employer

Notify your employer in writing within 30 days of the injury – this protects your right to benefits.

2

### Get authorized medical care

See a provider authorized by the NY Workers’ Comp Board; the provider files the medical report on
your condition.

3

### File Form C-3

Submit your employee claim to the Board online, by mail or email, or in person – not by telephone.

4

### The carrier responds

The insurer must begin payments or formally dispute the claim, generally within about 18 days of
learning of the injury.

## The forms and players in a NY filing

───────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Form C-3           │Your employee claim, filed with the Workers’ Compensation Board
───────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Written notice     │Given to your employer within 30 days of the injury            
───────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Authorized provider│A Board-authorized doctor who files the medical report         
───────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18-day response    │When the carrier should start paying or controvert             
───────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
